CustomField.description: IM-126:This field will be calculated to inform user if they need to take any action for given grant and push changed to bgive.
CustomField.formula: OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Bgive_IM_Connection__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Bgive_IM_Connection__c, 'IM Managed'), ISPICKVAL( Funded_By_Multiple_Initiatives__c , 'No'), ISBLANK(Bgive_Id__c) ), AND(Confirmed_Budget_Amount_USD__c != 0,Budget_Amount_USD__c <> Confirmed_Budget_Amount_USD__c) , AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Bgive_Id__c)), Partner_Org__r.Bgive_Id__c <> Bgive_Program_Organization_Id__c ), IF(ISBLANK( Amendment_Bgive_Id__c ), Total_Amount_Local__c != Bgive_Amount_Local__c , Total_Amount_Local__c != Amendment_Future_Amount_Local__c ) )
CustomField.label: Pending Action
